title: Proverbs
author: Primarily associated with Solomon, with contributions from other wise men including Agur and Lemuel.
audience: God's people, especially those learning wisdom for faithful living.
historicalSetting: Proverbs teaches practical wisdom rooted in the fear of the Lord and applied to speech, work, family, justice, discipline, and character.
keyVerse: Proverbs 1:7 — "The fear of Yahweh is the beginning of knowledge."
christFocus: Proverbs points to Christ as the wisdom of God. True wisdom is found in fearing the Lord and walking in the way fulfilled perfectly by Jesus Christ.
outline: Words of Agur and Lemuel — Proverbs 30-31
